title: Once-per-open load guard → split content init from re-runnable schema refresh
trigger: Form/dialog load remote schema (decks, fields, config) once per open context via a ref guard; user fixes config in an embedded settings panel but the form stays stale until remount
principle: Split the load into 'content init' (once per open — prefill, draft) and 'schema refresh' (re-runnable, preserves user edits). Watch a settings signature → debounced schema refresh; record the settings generation each load actually used; generation counter invalidates in-flight stale writes.

cases.context: Card creator loadData guarded by loadedForRef → Anki settings edited in side panel never re-fetch → error alert + empty dropdowns persist until panel remount
cases.bad: useEffect(() => { if (loadedForRef.current === ctx) return; loadedForRef.current = ctx; void loadData(); }, [ctx, loadData]); // settings change → new loadData identity → guard blocks → stale

applyFor: React form hydrated once from remote config
Embedded settings panel editing connection config used by the parent form
Any once-per-mount loader whose inputs can change while mounted
Debounced reaction to per-keystroke settings writes
